biggest_catch: You must add your card AND link each merchant's offer before you swipe — pay at a participating store without linking the offer first and you earn $0.
catches: Two required steps: add the credit card to your Rakuten profile AND click 'Link Offer' for each merchant — either missing means no cash back.
In-store offers are only valid for physical-store purchases, not online.
Offer availability and rates vary by merchant and change frequently — 1–15% is the catalog range, not a guarantee.
Cash back posts up to 7 days after purchase — it is not instant.
You share card transaction data with Rakuten's offer network.

steps: Go to the In-Store Cash Back section and add your credit card(s) to your profile.
Browse participating local merchants and click 'Link Offer' on each offer you want.
Pay in-store with the linked card at those merchants.
Cash back is added to your Rakuten account up to 7 days after purchase; Rakuten pays out quarterly via PayPal or check.
timing: Cash back posts up to 7 days after the in-store purchase; Rakuten pays out quarterly (Big Fat Check) via PayPal/check.
